_note: The coach's TOPICS (session C3, GDD 4.9.2): the 0-2 questions with replies that come with the Sunday-evening week talk (topic 'week'), one follow-up after a race (topic 'race'), and the plain 'Thanks, coach' of a talk without a topic (topic 'ack'). They are normal storylets (format in README.md) with a `topic` field: the scheduler never picks them for the 3-5 moments a week; CoachTalk / StoryletSystem post them with the talk. The first topic is part of the talk's stop; a second one waits in the coach thread (6 days). Voice-neutral wording, so they fit all four coach personalities. Real content (not test).

text: {name}, this is how Sundays go: we look back at the week, then at the week ahead. If something worries you, say so. Anything you want to ask?

replies.label: Why do we train this way?
replies.result: Good question. Every session has a reason, and I'll explain each one as we go.

replies.label: No, sounds good
replies.result: Good. Then we get to work.

replies.label: Do I have to talk every Sunday?
replies.result: Yes. It takes five minutes and it saves us both trouble.

text: {name}, you were sore this week. Is there something you are not telling me?
I noticed you were not moving freely this week. Is anything hurting?

replies.label: It's just normal soreness
replies.result: Fine. I'll keep an eye on it this week, and so should you.

replies.label: It's bothering me, actually
replies.result: Thank you for saying it. A sore spot told early is a short problem. Watch it this week.

replies.label: Don't worry about it
replies.result: I worry because it is my job. Be straight with me next time.

text: You looked tired at the end of the week, {name}. Is the load too much for you?
Your legs were heavy all week. Tell me honestly: is this too much?

replies.label: I can handle it
replies.result: All right. But I watch your legs, not your words.

replies.label: A lighter week would help
replies.result: Then we are honest with each other. Good. I will keep it in mind for the plan.

replies.label: I'm not sure
replies.result: Then we watch it together this week.

text: Your legs looked fresh this week, {name}. Could you take a bit more?
You came through this week with energy to spare. Do you want more from the plan?

replies.label: Yes, I want more
replies.result: I like that. We build carefully, but yes, we can add.

replies.label: No, this is right
replies.result: Good. A plan that fits is worth more than a hard one.

replies.label: Let me see how I feel
replies.result: Sensible. If you stay this fresh, I'll ask again.

text: {meet} is this week. How are you feeling about it?
Race week, {name}: {meet}. What is going on in your head?

replies.label: Excited
replies.result: Good. Keep that, and keep your legs fresh.

replies.label: A bit nervous
replies.result: Nerves mean you care. We make a plan so you know what to do.

replies.label: Just another race
replies.result: Then treat it like one: sleep, eat, warm up properly.

text: That personal best of {pb} was no accident, {name}. What do you want from the rest of the season?

replies.label: Go faster still
replies.result: Then we keep working. One step at a time.

replies.label: Enjoy it for a bit
replies.result: You have earned it. A few days of enjoying it is part of the work.

replies.label: I don't know yet
replies.result: That is fine. We have time.

text: These easy weeks can feel pointless, {name}. How do you feel about them?

replies.label: I needed the rest
replies.result: Good. A rested body trains better.

replies.label: I'm getting restless
replies.result: I know. Be patient, the real work starts soon.

replies.label: I'd rather keep training
replies.result: I hear you. Not yet. But I will remember it.

text: {name}, what do you want from this year? A final, a personal best, or just to learn?

replies.label: Reach a final
replies.result: Then we plan for a final.

replies.label: A personal best
replies.result: A clear goal. I like that.

replies.label: Learn and enjoy it
replies.result: A good attitude. The results follow.

text: How is the recovery going, {name}? Are you following the limits?

replies.label: Yes, every day
replies.result: Good. Patience is the hardest training there is.

replies.label: I tried a bit more
replies.result: Don't. It costs more time than it saves.

replies.label: It's hard to sit still
replies.result: I know. That is what the cross-training is for: the bike, the pool, aqua jogging.

replies.label: Amazing
replies.result: Enjoy it. You earned every second of it.

replies.label: I want to go even faster
replies.result: Then the work goes on. But first, rest tomorrow.

replies.label: I was lucky
replies.result: It was not luck. Luck does not train twice a day.

text: A good race today, {name}. What did you notice out there?

replies.label: I felt strong
replies.result: Good. Remember that feeling.

replies.label: It was harder than it looked
replies.result: Racing always is. That is why we train.

replies.label: I could have done more
replies.result: Then we find out where. We'll look at the race together.

text: That one stung, I know. How are you, {name}?

replies.label: I'll bounce back
replies.result: I know you will. Rest first.

replies.label: I'm really disappointed
replies.result: It is allowed. Tonight you are disappointed, tomorrow we learn from it.

replies.label: I don't want to talk about it
replies.result: All right. We talk when you are ready.

text: Are you hurt, {name}? Tell me the truth.

replies.label: I'm fine
replies.result: Good. If anything feels wrong tomorrow, take it easy.

replies.label: I'm sore and shaken
replies.hint: {He} will keep an eye on you
replies.result: Then rest. I will watch your next days closely.

replies.label: Just disappointed
replies.result: That is allowed. It was not your fault.
